1: // Simple Asteroid Miner game
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
8:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Ship
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: WIDTH / 2,
13:     y: HEIGHT / 2,
14:     r: 12,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     speed: 0,
17:     maxSpeed: 4,
18:     accel: 0.1,
19:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
20:     fuel: 1000,
21:     score: 0,
22:     alive: true,
23:   };
24: 
25:   // Asteroids pool
26:   const asteroids = [];
27:   const AST_COUNT = 30;
28:   for (let i = 0; i < AST_COUNT; i++) {
29:     asteroids.push({
30:       x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
31:       y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
32:       r: 15 + Math.random() * 20,
33:       vx: -1 + Math.random() * 2,
34:       vy: -1 + Math.random() * 2,
35:     });
36:   }
37: 
38:   // Input handling
39:   const keys = {};
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
41:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
42: 
43:   function update() {
44:     if (!ship.alive) return;
45:     // Controls
46:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
47:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
48:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.speed = Math.min(ship.speed + ship.accel, ship.maxSpeed);
49:     else ship.speed = Math.max(ship.speed - ship.accel * 0.5, 0);
50: 
51:     // Move ship
52:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
53:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
54:     ship.fuel--;
55:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) ship.alive = false;
56: 
57:     // Wrap around edges
58:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += WIDTH;
59:     if (ship.x > WIDTH) ship.x -= WIDTH;
60:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += HEIGHT;
61:     if (ship.y > HEIGHT) ship.y -= HEIGHT;
62: 
63:     // Update asteroids and check collisions
64:     for (const a of asteroids) {
65:       a.x += a.vx;
66:       a.y += a.vy;
67:       if (a.x < 0) a.x += WIDTH;
68:       if (a.x > WIDTH) a.x -= WIDTH;
69:       if (a.y < 0) a.y += HEIGHT;
70:       if (a.y > HEIGHT) a.y -= HEIGHT;
71: 
72:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
73:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
74:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
75:       if (dist < a.r + ship.r) {
76:         // Collision: if speed low, mine; else crash
77:         if (ship.speed < 1) {
78:           ship.score += Math.floor(a.r);
79:           // respawn asteroid
80:           a.x = Math.random() * WIDTH;
81:           a.y = Math.random() * HEIGHT;
82:           a.r = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
83:           a.vx = -1 + Math.random() * 2;
84:           a.vy = -1 + Math.random() * 2;
85:         } else {
86:           ship.alive = false;
87:         }
88:       }
89:     }
90:   }
91: 
92:   function draw() {
93:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
94:     // Ship
95:     ctx.save();
96:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
97:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
100:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
101:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
102:     ctx.closePath();
103:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.alive ? '#0f0' : '#f00';
104:     ctx.fill();
105:     ctx.restore();
106: 
107:     // Asteroids
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
109:     for (const a of asteroids) {
110:       ctx.beginPath();
111:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
112:       ctx.fill();
113:     }
114: 
115:     // HUD
116:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
117:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
118:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${ship.score}`, 10, 20);
119:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${ship.fuel}`, 10, 40);
120:     if (!ship.alive) ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2 - 40, HEIGHT / 2);
121:   }
122: 
123:   function loop() {
124:     update();
125:     draw();
126:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127:   }
128:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
129: })();

(End of file - total 129 lines)
